name: poster-original
description: The agency poster grid in its real colours: electric-blue slides with a deep-navy vignette alternate with flat studio-grey slides. Blue slides shout in heavy condensed caps, grey slides in wide black caps, one copperplate script word as the accent, a ghost word echoing down the slide, navy calligraphic swoops, neon-yellow / magenta / lime sticker chips and a black pill footer bar.
source: themes/poster/refs/ref-3.png + ref-4.png (agency social-media poster grids), kept in their own palette and type feel, October 2026
best_for: loud one-idea hooks, launches and offers
short punchy carousels where every slide is a poster
grid-led profiles that alternate blue and grey tiles

variant: (electric blue + studio grey alternating, the only look)
fonts: display = Mrs Saint Delafield: only the *emphasis* word (script accent)
body = Archivo variable: condensed 62% caps on blue slides, wide 125% caps on grey slides, normal width for reading copy and labels
mono = JetBrains Mono: terminal lines inside visuals only
slide_fields: ghost: the big background word (cover, stat, any slide); empty = no ghost
fill: true turns a slide into a black poster
